meta.title: OSIDAC — Your store never sleeps. Neither should your income.
meta.description: A free virtual-store MVP: claim internal OSID Coins every 8 hours and try daily missions. Partner offers and cash withdrawals are planned for Phase 2. No crypto or guaranteed earnings.

hero.badge: Open · claim · grow — free to start
hero.title: Your store never sleeps. Neither should your income.
hero.subtitle: Start a free virtual store, claim internal OSID Coins every 8 hours, and complete daily in-app missions. Paid partner offers and cash withdrawals are not live yet; both are planned for Phase 2. No crypto. No guaranteed income.
hero.imageAlt: Happy member holding a phone with her mini store and floating coins

how.title: Open. Claim. Cash out.
how.subtitle: Phase 1 is a free app loop with internal coins only. Paid partner offers, franchise checkout and cash withdrawals are not live yet.
how.buyHook: Start free. Upgrade options come later.
how.buyText: No package is available to purchase in this MVP. The five price tiers and voucher/merch benefits shown below are indicative plans and may change after partner and legal review.
how.buyAlt: Mini store on a phone with coins flowing into a wallet
how.getHook: Keep your store moving every 8 hours
how.getText: Claim OSID Coins and finish daily in-app actions. Coins have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn in Phase 1; paid partner missions and playtime are planned for Phase 2.
how.getAlt: Hands playing a mobile game with gifts and coins bursting out
how.wdHook: Cashout is planned — not live yet
how.wdText: DANA, GoPay, OVO, PayPal and bank payouts are planned for Phase 2 after payout and compliance reviews. Today, coins stay in your in-app wallet and cannot be withdrawn.
how.wdAlt: Happy man cashing out to his e-wallet in a cafe

earn.title: Start with your store. More engines are next.
earn.subtitle: The Phase 1 MVP offers free store claims and daily in-app missions in internal coins. Partner offers, playtime and network commissions are planned—not active yet.
earn.storeText: Your virtual store can be claimed every 8 hours. Rewards are internal OSID Coins only, with no cash value or withdrawal in Phase 1.
earn.missionText: The partner offerwall is not live in this MVP. Paid app installs, surveys and partner missions are planned for Phase 2.
earn.playText: Game-studio integrations and playtime rewards are planned for Phase 2; no partner-game payouts are active yet.
earn.teamText: Invite links and referral attribution work now. Network commissions are not paid in Phase 1; proposed rates require revenue and legal review before launch.

packages.title: Planned franchise tiers
packages.subtitle: Indicative pricing only—not for sale in this MVP. Checkout, vouchers and merch will be confirmed before any package launches.

starter.name: Starter Booth
starter.desc: Planned: Store Lv.2 · 1.2× mission multiplier · proposed $2.50 e-voucher. Not for sale yet.

kios.name: Kios Pro
kios.desc: Planned: Store Lv.4 · 1.4× multiplier · proposed $7.50 e-voucher and skin. Not for sale yet.

gold.name: Warung Gold
gold.desc: Planned: Store Lv.6 · 1.6× multiplier · proposed merch and $25 e-voucher. Not for sale yet.

elite.name: Franchise Elite
elite.desc: Planned: Store Lv.8 · 1.8× multiplier · proposed premium merch. Not for sale yet.

master.name: Empire Master
master.desc: Planned: Store Lv.10 · 2.0× multiplier · proposed community coaching. Not for sale yet.

network.title: Invite now. Network payouts later.
network.subtitle: Referral tracking is available, but no network commission is paid in Phase 1. The 3-level rates below are proposals for a future, revenue-funded program.
network.note: Proposed plan only—not active. Any future network payout is subject to verified revenue, compliance review and the 40% cap. Joining or buying a package will not be required.
network.imageAlt: Group of friends holding phones connected by glowing network lines

transparency.title: Where the money actually comes from
transparency.subtitle: Before real-money payouts launch, OSIDAC will publish verified revenue and distribution reporting. Until then, all coins shown in the MVP are internal only; no member receives cash withdrawals.
transparency.formula: Future policy target: member payouts ≤ 70% of verified revenue
transparency.disclaimer: OSIDAC is a product-and-rewards MVP, not an investment. Earnings are not guaranteed. OSID Coins have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn in Phase 1. No crypto is used.

cta.title: Your first store claim is 8 hours away.
cta.subtitle: Open a free store and start with internal coins. Cash withdrawals are planned for Phase 2.

footer.legal: OSIDAC is not an investment product and does not promise returns. Phase 1 OSID Coins are internal only and cannot be withdrawn. Package tiers and paid partner features shown on this site are plans, not live checkout or earning offers.
